name: studio
title: Studio
description: A white-cube portfolio for designers and photographers whose signature is a full-bleed, edge-to-edge project grid on a bare gallery wall, labelled in small uppercase wall-label type with one red dot of colour — photographs carry the page when you have them, typographic plates when you don't.

tokens.--font-display: typeface for the studio name, page titles and project titles
tokens.--font-body: typeface for everything you read at length, and for the small labels
tokens.--text-xs: size of wall labels — menu, tile labels, client and year, footer (uppercase, spaced out)
tokens.--text-s: size of section headings in a page's text, and of code
tokens.--text-l: size of the opening sentence on a project page and of titles in a list of posts
tokens.--text-plate: size of the project title on a tile that has no photograph
tokens.--text-xl: size of page titles and project titles — the one big voice
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of titles and headings
tokens.--leading-label: line height of labels, the opening sentence of a project and code
tokens.--weight-strong: boldness of titles, the studio name and project names in labels
tokens.--color-accent: the red dot — the current-page marker, focus rings, and links while hovered
tokens.--color-border: hairline rules — label rows, the project index, tables, the footer line
tokens.--color-code-bg: tinted panel — project tiles that have no photograph, and code blocks
tokens.--color-scrim: dark strip behind the label on a photograph in the grid
tokens.--color-on-image: label text set over a photograph in the grid
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--label-column: width of the left-hand column on wide screens, where section labels hang; text starts where it ends (a third of the screen lines text up with a three-across grid)
tokens.--space-1: spacing scale — hairline: the gap between a post title and its date
tokens.--space-2: spacing scale — tight: padding of label rows and index rows
tokens.--space-3: spacing scale — base: the page margin, tile padding and the gap between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: spacing scale — roomy: the gap under a page title and above a section
tokens.--space-5: spacing scale — section: the gap above page titles and the project index
tokens.--space-6: spacing scale — gallery: the big empty space above the footer
tokens.--grid-gap: gap between tiles in the work grid
tokens.--grid-min: minimum width of a work-grid tile — smaller means more tiles across
tokens.--card-ratio: shape of work-grid tiles: width divided by height, e.g. 1.3333 for 4:3, 1 for square, 0.8 for portrait
tokens.--cover-max-height: tallest the photograph at the top of a project page may be
tokens.--radius: corner rounding — 0, gallery edges are square
tokens.--dot-size: diameter of the red dot, relative to the label text beside it
